notes: Stack: Foundry, solc 0.8.27, EVM Prague (EIP-1153 transient storage available), optimizer on 777 runs, via-ir=false (foundry.toml). ERC-7579 modular account on ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7; UUPS upgradeable (Solady); ERC-7739 signature validation; EIP-7702 delegation incl. PREP flow. All 18 scope files use pragma ^0.8.27.

contracts/Nexus.sol:62 Nexus inherits INexus, BaseAccount, ExecutionHelper, ModuleManager, UUPSUpgradeable (Solady), ComposableExecutionBase (@biconomy/composability). EIP-712 domain name 'Nexus', version '1.2.1' (Nexus.sol:574-577); account id 'biconomy.nexus.1.2.1' (BaseAccount.sol:30).

contracts/Nexus.sol:102-137 validateUserOp (onlyEntryPoint, payPrefund): nonce-driven dispatch via NonceLib — validate mode (no-op branch), module-enable mode (_enableMode), PREP mode (require !isInitialized, _handlePREP, _initializeAccount); then _handleValidator on the nonce-embedded validator address, _withPreValidationHook (ERC-4337), then IValidator.validateUserOp. Return value is the validator's validationData, passed through.

contracts/lib/NonceLib.sol:11-59 nonce layout [3 bytes empty][1 byte validation mode][20 bytes validator][8 bytes nonce]; mode byte 3: 0x00 validate, 0x01 module-enable, 0x02 PREP (Constants.sol:54-56). getValidator extracts the 20-byte validator via assembly shift; isDefaultValidatorMode checks validator == address(0).

contracts/base/BaseAccount.sol:36-48 onlyEntryPoint requires msg.sender == immutable _ENTRYPOINT (set once in Nexus constructor, Nexus.sol:79-82, zero-address rejected); onlyEntryPointOrSelf additionally allows address(this). payPrefund (BaseAccount.sol:55-64) runs AFTER the function body and calls caller() with missingAccountFunds, ignoring failure.

contracts/Nexus.sol:144 execute is onlyEntryPoint + withHook; Nexus.sol:162-185 executeFromExecutor is onlyExecutorModule + withHook + withRegistry(msg.sender, MODULE_TYPE_EXECUTOR) and returns returnData. Both decode mode via ModeLib.decodeBasic and dispatch SINGLE/BATCH/DELEGATECALL, else revert UnsupportedCallType. executeUserOp (Nexus.sol:190-196) is onlyEntryPoint + withHook and delegatecalls address(this) with userOp.callData[4:]. executeComposable (Nexus.sol:201-203) is onlyEntryPoint + withHook and delegates to ComposableExecutionBase._executeComposable (dependency code); _executeAction (Nexus.sol:210-212) forwards to ExecutionHelper._executeMemory.

contracts/base/ExecutionHelper.sol:39-203 _execute/_executeMemory/_executeNoReturndata/_tryExecute and delegatecall variants are memory-safe assembly forwarding full gas(); DEFAULT variants bubble reverts, TRY variants capture (success, result). _handleSingle/Batch/DelegateCallExecution (lines 205-237) drop returndata for EntryPoint path; AndReturnData variants (lines 240-284) return it for the executor path. TRY failures emit TryExecuteUnsuccessful / TryDelegateCallUnsuccessful; DEFAULT batch/single failures revert the whole call.

contracts/lib/ModeLib.sol:87-103 decode/decodeBasic extract CallType (byte 0), ExecType, ModeSelector, ModePayload from the 32-byte ExecutionMode via assembly shifts; decodeBasic ignores selector/payload. CALLTYPE_SINGLE=0x00, BATCH=0x01, STATIC=0xFE, DELEGATECALL=0xFF; EXECTYPE_DEFAULT=0x00, TRY=0x01 (ModeLib.sol:64-79). supportsExecutionMode (Nexus.sol:425-433) accepts SINGLE/BATCH/DELEGATECALL x DEFAULT/TRY only.

contracts/lib/ExecLib.sol:38-70 decodeBatch is Solady-derived assembly with bounds checks reverting DecodingError(); decodeSingle (lines 75-79) reads target[0:20], value[20:52], callData[52:]; decodeDelegateCall (lines 81-85) reads delegate[0:20], callData[20:]. get2771CallData (lines 11-36) appends msg.sender (shifted) after full calldata for fallback-handler calls.

contracts/Nexus.sol:226-233 installModule is onlyEntryPointOrSelf, no withHook on the external function (hook checks run inside each _install* via withHook); emits ModuleInstalled. uninstallModule (Nexus.sol:248-264) is onlyEntryPointOrSelf + withHook, requires _isModuleInstalled first, then dispatches per type; validator uninstall additionally runs _checkInitializedValidators. MODULE_TYPE_MULTI (0) has no uninstall branch in uninstallModule.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:191-214 _installModule lazily inits sentinel lists, rejects module == address(0), and dispatches VALIDATOR/EXECUTOR/FALLBACK/HOOK/PREVALIDATION_HOOK/MULTI, else reverts InvalidModuleTypeId. Each _install* carries withHook + withRegistry and checks isModuleType on the module before pushing/setting state and calling onInstall. _installValidator (lines 216-234) additionally reverts DefaultValidatorAlreadyInstalled for the immutable default validator.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:236-248 _uninstallValidator and _uninstallExecutor (lines 267-274) abi.decode deInitData as (prev, disableModuleData), pop from the sentinel list FIRST, then call onUninstall via excessivelySafeCall with gasleft() and ignore the result. _uninstallHook (lines 296-305) clears hook/pre-validation-hook state first, then excessivelySafeCall onUninstall. _uninstallFallbackHandler (lines 359-362) clears the selector mapping first, then excessivelySafeCall with data[4:].

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:407-451 _multiTypeInstall parses (uint256[] types, bytes[] initDatas) via LocalCallDataParserLib.parseMultiTypeInitData, requires equal lengths, and loops dispatching each known type to its _install* (each with its own withHook + withRegistry). Types that match none of the branches are skipped by the loop with no else/revert — this exact behavior is already claimed in EX-071 (issue #319) and EX-086 (closed #322): dedup, do not re-claim.

contracts/lib/local/LocalCallDataParserLib.sol:14-46 parseEnableModeData reads module (20 bytes), moduleType (32 bytes), then length-prefixed moduleInitData and enableModeSignature (4-byte big-endian lengths), remainder is userOpSignature. parseMultiTypeInitData (lines 48-64) decodes two calldata offsets as (uint256[], bytes[]) via assembly with no bounds validation of its own.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:155-184 _enableMode parses packedData, takes the enable-mode-sig validator from the first 20 bytes of enableModeSignature, verifies via _checkEnableModeSignature over _getEnableModeDataHash, then calls this.installModule (external self-call, so onlyEntryPointOrSelf passes as address(this)). _checkEnableModeSignature (lines 515-536) hashes with Solady _hashTypedData and try/catches isValidSignatureWithSender, returning false on revert. _getEnableModeDataHash (lines 652-654) is pure and binds module, moduleType, userOpHash, and keccak256(initData) under MODULE_ENABLE_MODE_TYPE_HASH. Enable-mode replay/type/scope behavior is heavily covered ground: EX-003/004/008/016/017/019/025/039/054/068/073.

contracts/Nexus.sol:266-302 emergencyUninstallHook has NO caller modifier: anyone may call it; authorization is the validator signature checked by _checkEmergencyUninstallSignature plus a timelock state machine (1-day _EMERGENCY_TIMELOCK, Nexus.sol:68): first call starts the timelock, a call after 3x timelock resets it, a call after 1x timelock uninstalls and clears it, otherwise reverts EmergencyTimeLockNotExpired. Only HOOK and PREVALIDATION_HOOK types are accepted. Timelock/hook-bypass behavior is covered ground: EX-020/046/063/074.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:453-464 _checkEmergencyUninstallSignature takes the validator from the first 20 bytes of signature, builds the EIP-712 hash via _getEmergencyUninstallDataHash (EMERGENCY_UNINSTALL_TYPE_HASH over hook, hookType, keccak256(deInitData), nonce), requires nonces[nonce] unused, marks it used BEFORE the signature check, then requires isValidSignatureWithSender(address(this), hash, signature[20:]) == ERC1271_MAGICVALUE.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:637-648 _handleValidator maps address(0) to the immutable _DEFAULT_VALIDATOR with no installed-check, and requires _isValidatorInstalled for any non-zero address. The default validator is therefore usable without ever appearing in the validators sentinel list; default-validator addressing is covered ground: EX-049/072, EX-046/048/053/058.

contracts/Nexus.sol:306-334 initializeAccount: if msg.sender != address(this), the 7702 path takes a 65-byte signature prefix, requires !isInitialized(), requires erc7702InitHashes[keccak256(initData)] unused, requires ECDSA.recover(initDataHash, sig) == address(this), then marks the hash used; the classic path calls Initializable.requireInitializable() (transient flag, consumed — PR #302 / EX-116). The msg.sender == address(this) branch performs NONE of these checks before _initializeAccount — this re-init path was Hunter candidate H-B1 in Option 1 and was DISPROVED (Referee NOT_A_BUG, zero incremental privilege): do not re-claim it. _initializeAccount (Nexus.sol:336-356) parses (bootstrap, bootstrapCall) from initData via assembly and delegatecalls the caller-supplied bootstrap address with no allowlist; the post-init isInitialized() check is skipped for 7702 accounts.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:624-635 _amIERC7702 returns true only when extcodesize(address()) == 23 AND the first 3 code bytes equal 0xef0100. It gates: the 7702 relay-init branch, the _initializeAccount post-check skip, _checkInitializedValidators skip, and the _authorizeUpgrade revert.

contracts/Nexus.sol:374-394 isValidSignature: empty signature + hash == (~0/0xffff)*0x7739 routes to checkERC7739Support; otherwise the validator is the first 20 bytes of signature (via _handleValidator), the ERC-1271 pre-validation hook may rewrite (hash, signature), and isValidSignatureWithSender is try/caught, returning 0xffffffff on revert. Short/empty-signature revert behavior is covered ground: EX-078/088; zero-owner malformed-signature behavior in K1Validator is EX-077/087 (context-only file).

contracts/Nexus.sol:486-509 checkERC7739Support iterates the validators sentinel list plus _DEFAULT_VALIDATOR, keeping the highest SUPPORTS_ERC7739-prefixed (0x77390000) version via _get7739Version, which calls isValidSignatureWithSender WITHOUT try/catch; empty result returns 0xffffffff. The no-try/catch claim is EX-069 (issue #321) and 7739-detection coverage is EX-042/048/058: dedup, do not re-claim.

contracts/Nexus.sol:462-481 upgradeToAndCall is public payable + withHook, requires non-zero implementation with extcodesize > 0, writes the new implementation to the address()-keyed slot (Biconomy V2 compat) and then calls Solady UUPSUpgradeable.upgradeToAndCall. _authorizeUpgrade (Nexus.sol:511-518) is onlyEntryPointOrSelf and reverts for 7702 accounts. getImplementation (Nexus.sol:397-409) reads the ERC-1967 slot, falling back to the address() slot.

contracts/Nexus.sol:554-572 _checkInitializedValidators is skipped for 7702 accounts and when the default validator reports initialized; otherwise it walks the validators sentinel list calling isInitialized on each and reverts CanNotRemoveLastValidator if none is initialized. Loop-DoS and reverting-validator blocking claims are EX-075 (issue #309) and EX-081 (issue #300); last-validator deletion is EX-055: dedup, do not re-claim.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:66-90 onlyExecutorModule requires msg.sender in the executors sentinel list. withHook calls IHook.preCheck(msg.sender, msg.value, msg.data) before the body and postCheck(hookData) after, only when a hook is installed. The constructor (lines 85-91) requires the default validator to report MODULE_TYPE_VALIDATOR and calls its onInstall. receive() is an empty payable function; fallback() forwards to _fallback.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:656-713 _fallback dispatches on msg.sig: an installed handler runs with MANUAL hook pre/post checks (not the withHook modifier), STATIC via staticcall, SINGLE via call forwarding msg.value, both with ExecLib.get2771CallData; handler reverts are bubbled via assembly and results returned via assembly. With no handler, onERC721Received/onERC1155Received/onERC1155BatchReceived selectors return msg.sig; anything else reverts MissingFallbackHandler. Fallback authorization/calltype behavior is covered ground: EX-006/014/024/026/027/028/036.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:314-357 _installFallbackHandler parses selector (4 bytes) + calltype (1 byte) + initData from params, requires STATIC or SINGLE calltype, forbids selectors 0x6d61fe70 (onInstall), 0x8a91b0e3 (onUninstall), and 0x00000000, and forbids overwriting an installed selector. _installHook (lines 276-294) requires no current hook; _installPreValidationHook (lines 368-385) requires no current hook of that type.

contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:471-513 _withPreValidationHook (ERC-4337, non-view) delegates to the installed pre-validation hook's preValidationHookERC4337 and returns its rewritten (hash, signature); the ERC-1271 variant (view) does the same via preValidationHookERC1271 with msg.sender. With no hook installed both return inputs unchanged.

contracts/base/RegistryAdapter.sol:19-53 withRegistry calls _checkRegistry, which is a NO-OP when storage registry == address(0) (opt-in) and otherwise calls moduleRegistry.check(module, moduleType), reverting on insufficient attestation. _configureRegistry stores the registry and, when non-zero, calls newRegistry.trustAttesters(threshold, attesters) — an external call into untrusted-at-config-time registry code. Nexus.setRegistry (Nexus.sol:363-365) requires msg.sender == address(this). Registry gaps are covered ground: EX-002/018/023/034/039/059/060; registry removal in the 1.3.x lineage and the dev branch is a scope caveat (SCOPE.md §5a/§6).

contracts/base/Storage.sol:27-39 _getAccountStorage returns the ERC-7201 namespaced slot 0x0bb70095...b82f00 for 'biconomy.storage.Nexus'. AccountStorage (IStorage.sol) holds: validators/executors sentinel lists, fallbacks mapping, hook, emergencyUninstallTimelock mapping, both pre-validation hooks, nonces replay mapping, registry address, erc7702InitHashes replay mapping.

contracts/base/BaseAccount.sol:67-96 addDeposit is permissionless payable and forwards callvalue() to the EntryPoint via call, reverting on failure. withdrawDepositTo (onlyEntryPointOrSelf) uses assembly to call EntryPoint.withdrawTo(to, amount) and restores the overwritten free-memory-pointer word. getDeposit uses assembly staticcall to EntryPoint.balanceOf. The free-memory-pointer claim is EX-040: dedup.

contracts/types/Constants.sol:28-44 module-type ids: MULTI=0, VALIDATOR=1, EXECUTOR=2, FALLBACK=3, HOOK=4, PREVALIDATION_HOOK_ERC1271=8, PREVALIDATION_HOOK_ERC4337=9 (ids 5/6/7 unassigned). EIP-712 type hashes: MODULE_ENABLE_MODE_TYPE_HASH and EMERGENCY_UNINSTALL_TYPE_HASH are hardcoded constants (lines 48-51); EIP-712 compatibility claims are EX-008/068/121: dedup.

contracts/lib/EnumerableMap4337.sol (535 lines) and contracts/lib/EnumerableSet4337.sol (371 lines) are OZ-derived ERC-4337 associated-storage forks; contracts/lib/AssociatedArrayLib.sol (276 lines) provides the associated-storage array primitives EnumerableSet builds on. Reachability verified by grep: EnumerableMap has NO importers in contracts/ or test/; AssociatedArrayLib is imported only by EnumerableSet4337; EnumerableSet is used in production code only by K1Validator (context-only file, _safeSenders set). Hunter effort here must establish a reachable caller before any account-impact claim.

contracts/lib/ModuleTypeLib.sol:15-47 isType/bitEncode/bitEncodeCalldata bitmask helpers: ZERO call sites found in contracts/ or test/ outside the file itself (only mocks/tests import the EncodedModuleTypes/ModuleType types). contracts/lib/BytesLib.sol:12-24 slice(): zero call sites outside its own file. contracts/lib/BootstrapLib.sol:18-56 pure config builders; only production caller is K1ValidatorFactory (context-only). Duplicate-bitEncode behavior is EX-029: dedup.

Concurrency/reentrancy surfaces (verified call sites, no claims): hook preCheck runs BEFORE each guarded body and postCheck AFTER it (ModuleManager.sol:73-82, 668/688), with arbitrary external calls in between (execution, onInstall, fallback dispatch); onInstall is called as a plain external call that CAN revert the install (ModuleManager.sol:230/261/289/353/382) while onUninstall is fire-and-forget via excessivelySafeCall (lines 244/270/302/361); validators are called during validation (Nexus.sol:136/387/501, ModuleManager.sol:462/525) and isInitialized is an external view call into validator code (Nexus.sol:447/555/560); fallback handlers receive calls with msg.value (ModuleManager.sol:674); executeUserOp delegatecalls address(this) (Nexus.sol:192); _initializeAccount delegatecalls a caller-supplied bootstrap (Nexus.sol:350); no reentrancy guard modifier exists in the scope files — each path's safety rests on its access control and call ordering, which Hunters must trace per path.

State/error boundaries: TRY execution swallows target reverts and emits events (ExecutionHelper.sol:137-149, 205-237); DEFAULT execution reverts; enable-mode and 1271 signature checks convert validator reverts to failure values via try/catch (ModuleManager.sol:525-531, Nexus.sol:387-391) while _get7739Version and _checkEmergencyUninstallSignature let validator reverts propagate; uninstall paths never revert on onUninstall failure (excessivelySafeCall result ignored); _checkInitializedValidators reverts only after a full-list walk with no initialized validator.

Services/deps (pinned versions from SCOPE.md + remappings.txt): OpenZeppelin, account-abstraction v0.7.0 (PackedUserOperation, IEntryPoint), solady v0.1.9 (UUPSUpgradeable, EIP712, ECDSA), sentinellist v1.0.0 (SentinelListLib), erc7579, erc7739-validator-base v1.0.0, @biconomy/composability v1.1.0 (ComposableExecutionBase), excessively-safe-call, solarray. No off-chain services, oracles, or price feeds in scope; the only external on-chain trust anchors are the EntryPoint (immutable), the ERC-7484 registry (opt-in, account-configured), and installed modules (owner-installed, fully trusted once installed except where hook/registry gates apply).
